title: Free in every relationship
description: Editorial design for the Zurich Pride Magazine 2024, created for the 30th anniversary of Zurich Pride under the theme «Free in Every Relationship – for 30 Years». The magazine combines manifesto and program guide, highlighting diverse relationship models, queer perspectives, and social issues. With a print run of 10 000 copies, it was distributed across cultural spaces and queer meeting points in and around Zurich.
